robots.txt with explicit AI crawler allow rules — fixed

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Strong security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options)
Sitemap with 87 URLs and per-page lastModified dates
robots.txt with explicit AI crawler allow rules
www and trailing-slash redirects in place
All canonical tags correct on inner pages

findings.title: No X-Robots-Tag HTTP header for noindex routes
findings.description: Admin, SuiteCompare, and Import Doctor routes have robots meta noindex but no HTTP header equivalent
findings.recommendation: Add X-Robots-Tag: noindex header in next.config.ts headers() for /admin/*, /suitecompare/*, /importDetector/*

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Strong content volume (36 blogs + 30 resources) for a 2-month domain
Oracle certification credentialing in JSON-LD
Source citations (NetSuite release notes) in all 2026.2 posts
Top traffic post (NLAuth) now has 2 service page inline links

findings.title: 13 of 36 blog posts under 800 words (thin content)
findings.description: Mostly 2026.2 release-note micro-posts: currency-context (456w), bill-capture (480w), sales-order (571w), payment-adjustments (632w), project-health (680w), passkey-second-factor (698w), advanced-record-customization (716w), rest-batch-sequential (736w), suiteql-bound-parameters (740w), payment-runs (779w). Each too thin for passage indexing.
findings.recommendation: Expand each to 1,000+ words, or consolidate blog/resource pairs into one comprehensive page

findings.title: Blog articles open with context sentences, not direct answers
findings.description: All priority posts fail the AI citability test — actionable fact arrives 40-60 words in after scene-setting
findings.recommendation: Rewrite openers for 5 priority posts: NLAuth, User Event vs Client, Best Practices, Post-Go-Live Checklist, Workflow Mistakes. Pattern: direct answer (15-25 words) first, context second.

findings.title: No content targeting CFO/Controller search intent
findings.description: Zero posts for 'reduce NetSuite close time', 'NetSuite financial reporting', 'when to hire NetSuite consultant'

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: BlogPosting image property now present — all posts qualify for Article rich results
TechArticle image property added to resources pages
ProfessionalService scoped to homepage only
WebSite schema on homepage
BreadcrumbList correct on all inner pages

findings.title: /blog listing page has zero JSON-LD
findings.description: No BreadcrumbList or ItemList on the blog index page
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbJsonLd and an ItemList of recent posts to app/(site)/blog/page.tsx

findings.title: Service pages have no Service-type schema
findings.description: Only BreadcrumbList + FAQPage on service pages. No schema.org/Service entity signals.
findings.recommendation: Create ServiceJsonLd component, apply to /hire-netsuite-developer first

categories.name: SXO
what_works: hire-netsuite-developer form now at position ~4/15 (was 14/15)
Company field in LeadForm now optional
Case study social proof cards on hire page

findings.title: Every service page CTA button exits the page to /contact
findings.description: User loses scroll context and lands on generic form. Should anchor to inline form.
findings.recommendation: Change Button href='/contact' to href='#contact' and add id='contact' to each page's LeadForm wrapper

findings.title: 4 service pages have only 1 form, placed after FAQ
findings.description: post-go-live, consulting, SuiteScript, and admin pages each have a single LeadForm at the very bottom
findings.recommendation: Add mid-page LeadForm after the 'What we cover' section on each of the 4 pages

findings.title: No pricing context anywhere
findings.description: CFOs cannot self-qualify. Competitors state '$3,000-$10,000/month' explicitly.
findings.recommendation: Add one honest paragraph on engagement model and starting scope — not a fixed price, just context

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: robots.txt with explicit AI crawler allow rules
Server-side rendered — JSON-LD visible to AI crawlers
llms.txt with full blog index, 14 FAQ pairs, RSL 1.0 licensing
Strong schema coverage (ProfessionalService, WebSite, BlogPosting)

findings.title: No Reddit or YouTube presence
findings.description: Reddit correlates strongly with AI citations; YouTube is the #1 off-site signal (~0.737 correlation). SuitePacific has neither.
findings.recommendation: Start with Reddit r/netsuite: 2-3 expert technical answers per week. YouTube is longer-term.

findings.title: Blog H2 headings are declarative, not question-format
findings.description: AI intent-matching favors H2s that mirror user queries. 'What a Client Script actually is' should be 'When should you use a Client Script in NetSuite?'
findings.recommendation: Convert 3-5 H2s per priority article to question format. Content doesn't change.

categories.name: Content Clusters
what_works: SuiteScript cluster has 4 blog spokes + service page
FreeMarker PDF guide appearing in SERP for advanced PDF queries
Release-note posts now all link to service pages

findings.title: Integrations cluster has zero blog spokes
findings.description: No blog content for 'NetSuite RESTlet', 'NetSuite OAuth setup', 'how to integrate NetSuite'. Service page /netsuite-integrations invisible to organic discovery.
findings.recommendation: First post: 'How to Build a NetSuite RESTlet in SuiteScript 2.x'

findings.title: Administrator support cluster has zero blog spokes
findings.description: Both /netsuite-administrator-support and /netsuite-admin-support-small-business have no blog funnel
findings.recommendation: First post: 'NetSuite User Roles and Permissions: A Setup Guide'

findings.title: No hub-level blog posts in any cluster
findings.description: Service pages don't rank for informational queries. Buyers searching 'netsuite saved searches guide' see Forvis Mazars, AnchorGroup, YRK — not SuitePacific, despite 2 relevant spokes.
findings.recommendation: Write 'NetSuite Saved Searches: Complete Guide' as first hub post — aggregates both existing spokes and targets the broad head keyword

categories.name: Backlinks
what_works: 66 content pages is a strong link-attraction surface
Entity schema well-formed for when links arrive
Time-sensitive release-note content (FSM, NLAuth) has short distribution window

findings.title: Zero referring domains — domain not yet in Common Crawl
findings.description: Domain launched June 2026; Common Crawl most recent release is Jan-Mar 2026. No backlink data available from any source.
findings.recommendation: Priority link-building: NetSuite/AppSource directory listings, Reddit expert answers, client site mentions. Set up Moz free tier for DA tracking.

findings.title: Zero outbound source citations in release-note posts
findings.description: All 2026.2 posts reference NetSuite release notes but don't link to Oracle's source URLs
findings.recommendation: Add one primary-source outbound link per release-note post (NetSuite Help Center or release notes PDF)

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Add mid-page LeadForm to post-go-live, consulting, SuiteScript, admin support pages
Change CTA buttons to anchor links (#contact) on all service pages
Add ItemList + BreadcrumbList to /blog listing page

phases.name: Phase 2: Content & Citability
items: Rewrite article openers for 5 priority posts (direct answer first)
Convert declarative H2s to question-format headings
Write first integrations cluster post: 'How to Build a NetSuite RESTlet'
Write first admin support cluster post: 'NetSuite User Roles and Permissions Guide'

phases.name: Phase 3: Authority & Off-Site
items: Establish Reddit r/netsuite presence (2-3 expert answers/week for 4 weeks)
Add outbound Oracle source citations to release-note posts
Write 'NetSuite 2026.2: What Changed for Post-Go-Live Accounts' hub post
Write 'NetSuite Saved Searches: Complete Guide' hub post

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring
items: Set up Moz free tier for DA/PA tracking after next Common Crawl release
Add `updated` frontmatter when significantly revising blog posts
Run /seo-audit again in 6 weeks to measure score change
